validation.notes: Repaired DefaultResourceLoader.reload so the explicit resolveProjectTrust result is transferred to SettingsManager before the final settings reload and package resolution (previously it always forced false after bootstrap). The standalone regression loads the real resource-loader.ts through .prale-eval/subject.mjs and asserts: the bootstrap pass resolves packages untrusted and exposes only user/CLI extensions (no project extension); settings are reloaded with the explicit decision before final resource resolution; an explicit true applies even when the prior state was untrusted and loads user, project, and CLI extensions; an explicit false applies even when the prior state was trusted and keeps the project extension excluded. Ran the regression on the fixed checkout (exit 0) and replayed it against a temporary copy with the original setProjectTrusted(false) fault, where it failed with AssertionError (exit 1) at the settings-reload assertion, confirming fault detection. Vitest/TypeScript test dependencies are not installed in this workspace and were not installed; the requested VM-based regression is the focused validation.
